title: 2018 Porsche 911 GT2 RS Weissach: A Powerhouse

scenes.headline: 700 hp
scenes.narration: Seven hundred horsepower propels you to sixty in just 2.7 seconds, a staggering feat for any car.

scenes.headline: Most Powerful 911
scenes.narration: Launched as the most powerful road-going 911 ever, the GT2 RS sets a new standard for Porsche’s engineering.

scenes.headline: Weissach Package
scenes.narration: The optional Weissach Package drops an extra 40 pounds using carbon fiber components like intakes and interior elements.

scenes.headline: Turbocharged Powerplant
scenes.narration: Its 3.8-liter, twin-turbocharged flat-six generates 700 hp and 553 lb-ft of torque, routed through a 7-speed PDK transmission to the rear wheels.

scenes.headline: Rear-Wheel Drive
scenes.narration: This beast retains its thrilling rear-wheel-drive layout, ensuring a pure driving experience.

scenes.headline: Aerodynamic Mastery
scenes.narration: Massive air intakes and carbon fiber elements optimize airflow and cooling, a vital part of its track-focused design.

scenes.headline: Race-Ready Cockpit
scenes.narration: Inside, a carbon fiber steering wheel and bucket seats with Alcantara provide a track-inspired feel.

scenes.headline: Holds Its Value
scenes.narration: Originally priced at about $293,000, these machines still command values close to or above this amount, showcasing impressive retention.

scenes.headline: Is It Your Dream Car?
scenes.narration: With its sheer power and exclusivity, does the Porsche 911 GT2 RS Weissach earn a spot in your dream garage, or does the Italian flair of the Lamborghini pull you in?

script: Seven hundred horsepower propels you to sixty in just 2.7 seconds, a staggering feat for any car. Launched as the most powerful road-going 911 ever, the GT2 RS sets a new standard for Porsche’s engineering. The optional Weissach Package drops an extra 40 pounds using carbon fiber components like intakes and interior elements. Its 3.8-liter, twin-turbocharged flat-six generates 700 hp and 553 lb-ft of torque, routed through a 7-speed PDK transmission to the rear wheels. This beast retains its thrilling rear-wheel-drive layout, ensuring a pure driving experience. Massive air intakes and carbon fiber elements optimize airflow and cooling, a vital part of its track-focused design. Inside, a carbon fiber steering wheel and bucket seats with Alcantara provide a track-inspired feel. Originally priced at about $293,000, these machines still command values close to or above this amount, showcasing impressive retention. With its sheer power and exclusivity, does the Porsche 911 GT2 RS Weissach earn a spot in your dream garage, or does the Italian flair of the Lamborghini pull you in?

sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2018 Porsche 911 GT2 RS Weissach, finished in Guards Red with a black interior. The odometer on this 911 GT2 RS currently displays approximately 3,900 miles. The attached Carfax history report lists no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this Porsche's past. According to the build sheet provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes the Weissach Package, 20-inch front and 21-inch rear magnesium wheels, PCCBs, a front axle lift system, an extended range fuel tank, leather and Alcantara upholstery, carbon fiber full bucket seats, and a Bose sound system. Notable modifications reported by the selling dealer are limited to black-finished brake calipers. Launched for 2018 as a limited-edition model, the 991-based GT2 RS stood proud as the most powerful road-going 911 ever released. Porsche went to significant lengths to make the model as light as possible -- it notably fitted lighter springs, numerous carbon fiber parts, and cloth interior door handles. The optional Weissach Package -- which this car is equipped with -- saved an additional 40 pounds. Most sources agree that Porsche built around 1,000 units of the 991-based 911 GT2 RS. Power comes from a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter flat-6, rated at 700 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed PDK dual-clutch automatic transmission.
sections.Equipment: A build sheet is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment reported by the seller includes: Weissach Package Chrono Package with preparation for Lap Trigger 20-inch front and 21-inch rear magnesium wheels in black Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB) Front axle lift system Rear axle steering Extended range fuel tank Leather and Alcantara upholstery Carbon fiber full bucket seats Bose sound system
sections.Seller Notes: The selling dealer notes that the paint protection film has been applied to exterior panels. The selling dealer states that the magnesium wheels were uninstalled early in the vehicle's life and have been reinstalled in preparation for the sale, and that its Michelin Pilot Sport Cup 2 tires have about 9/32 of tread.
